en.title: Where to spot the world's last passenger Airbus A340s
en.summary: Lufthansa's final A340-600 passenger flight on October 18 ended 23 years of operations with the type and removed the last scheduled A340-600 service in Europe or North America, leaving Zurich, Frankfurt, Tehran and Caracas as the places where passenger A340s can still be found.
body: Lufthansa flew its final Airbus A340-600 passenger service on October 18, when flight LH419 departed Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) and landed at Frankfurt Airport (FRA) the following morning. The flight ended 23 years of operations for the airline, which owned 24 of the 97 A340-600s ever built, and it removed the last scheduled A340-600 service anywhere in Europe or North America. The aircraft held the title of the world's longest passenger jet until the Boeing 747-8 entered service, and Lufthansa configured its examples with 281 seats across four cabins, a figure a modern twinjet handles comfortably.

Zurich Airport (ZRH) is now the only airport in the world with two A340 operators based at it, with SWISS International Air Lines flying three active A340-300s and a fourth parked, and Edelweiss Air operating five. Edelweiss serves twelve destinations with the type in 2026, and some Edelweiss aircraft are loaned from SWISS, with Edelweiss operating the Zurich to Montreal route on behalf of SWISS under a wet-lease arrangement. Neither operation has long to run: SWISS has confirmed its remaining A340-300s will be gone by early 2028, with Shanghai Pudong and Johannesburg both moving to the A350-900 across the winter 2026/27 timetable, while Edelweiss is replacing its five aircraft with six A350-900s and ferried the first A340 to storage at Teruel in October 2025. Dubai International Airport (DXB) returns to the SWISS network on October 27, with the daily Zurich service planned to be operated mainly by the A340-300 through the winter season.

Frankfurt still has the A340-300 through 2027: nearly a dozen Lufthansa A340-300s remain in the fleet and are expected to be retired during 2027. The A340-600 now survives on scheduled passenger service at just two carriers, Mahan Air in Tehran and Conviasa in Caracas, both operating under sanctions that make the aircraft difficult to board and equally difficult to replace. After 2027, scheduled A340 passenger service in Western Europe ends, and what survives will sit largely outside the markets most readers can book. At least one aircraft will outlast the fleet in a different form: SWISS and the Swiss Museum of Transport announced in September that the airline's final A340-300 will be preserved as a permanent exhibit in Lucerne, with the airframe due to arrive by early 2028.

zh.title: 全球最後的客運A340還能在哪裡看到：蘇黎世、法蘭克福與僅存的-600航線
zh.summary: 漢莎10月18日的最後一班A340-600客運航班，結束了23年的營運，也讓歐洲與北美不再有定期A340-600服務；想再看到客運A340，得往蘇黎世、法蘭克福、德黑蘭與卡拉卡斯找。
body: 漢莎10月18日飛出最後一班空中巴士A340-600客運航班，LH419自華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場出發，隔天清晨降落法蘭克福機場。這班航班結束了漢莎23年的A340-600營運，漢莎曾擁有全部97架A340-600中的24架，也讓歐洲與北美不再有任何定期A340-600服務。A340-600曾是全球最長的客機，直到波音747-8投入服務才讓出頭銜；漢莎的A340-600採281席四艙配置，這個載客量現代雙發動機客機已能輕鬆應付。

蘇黎世機場如今是全球唯一有兩家A340業者駐點的機場：瑞士國際航空有3架現役A340-300、另1架停場，雪絨花航空則有5架。雪絨花2026年以A340飛航12個航點，部分飛機由瑞航借調，蘇黎世至蒙特婁航線更由雪絨花以濕租方式代表瑞航營運。不過兩家業者的A340時日都不多了：瑞航已確認剩餘A340-300將在2028年初前退役，上海浦東與約翰尼斯堡航線將在2026／27年冬季班表改由A350-900執飛；雪絨花則以6架A350-900取代5架A340，首架A340已在2025年10月送往特魯埃爾存放。杜拜國際機場（DXB）10月27日起重回瑞航航網，蘇黎世每日航班在冬季班表期間主要由A340-300執飛。

法蘭克福的A340-300還會留到2027年：漢莎機隊還剩近12架A340-300，預計2027年內退役。定期A340-600服務如今只剩兩家業者：德黑蘭的馬漢航空與卡拉卡斯的Conviasa，兩家都在制裁之下營運，訂票困難、換機也不容易。2027年之後，西歐的定期客運A340服務將畫下句點，倖存的飛機多半在一般旅客難以訂票的市場。至少有一架飛機會以另一種形式留下來：瑞航與瑞士交通博物館9月宣布，瑞航最後一架A340-300將永久保存為琉森的展品，機身預計2028年初前送達。
